subsystem.name: RuntimeObjectAndAudioLayer
subsystem.responsibility: DERIVED reconstruction of a mixed cluster of runtime objects: the filter-properties linked list, the F1CVehicle driver-record region (name/abbreviation/nationality/visibility), the per-vehicle telemetry packet encoder, the camera-tick list dispatch, the audio playlist manager with its node type, the audio scene manager, the sound-subsystem lifecycle/global-dispatch helpers and the SpecialFX reset object. Grouping is by shared callee contracts and shared field layouts; the owning-object tags come from the packet and are not original-source claims.

summary: DERIVED architecture proposal for 21 runtime-object functions. Cluster 1 - driver record (F1CVehicle): SetDriverName (0x004C6980) bounded-copies into this+0x4620 and derives the abbreviation via 0x004C6A10, which resolves an 'Abbreviation' data entry through the string-keyed list and emits a formatted abbreviation NUL-terminated at this+0x4707; NationalityDriverInfoLoader (0x004C78F0) fills the driver-region buffers from the 1060-byte-stride nationality array at dword_8AC394; SetDriverVisibility (0x004C7AA0) toggles bits at this+0x48BC and plays matching engine sounds. Cluster 2 - telemetry (0x004C71C0): a fixed encoder pipeline packs vehicle physics fields into a bitfield packet closed by 0x004B2AE0. Cluster 3 - filter-properties list (0x004C6150): prunes nodes whose built filter name matches any criterion. Cluster 4 - camera tick dispatch (0x004C7DE0): timer + list iteration with a vtable slot-40 dispatch on dword_8AC4C4. Cluster 5 - audio playlist manager (0x004C83B0/0x004C84A0/0x004C8650): teardown/rebuild/scan/playback over a head/tail/cursor/count list. Cluster 6 - scene manager (0x004C8920) and sound-subsystem lifecycle/dispatch helpers (0x004C82C0, 0x004C8AB0..0x004C8D70). Cluster 7 - SpecialFX reset (0x004CA280). No CONFIRMED claim is made about original source names or layout.

function_roles.role: Remove nodes from a filter-properties linked list whose built filter name matches any of the given criteria strings; unlink, optionally free node data, return the remaining count.
Set the driver full name: bounded copy into the 64-byte name buffer at this+0x4620, force NUL at this+0x465F, derive and return the abbreviated name via DriverAbbreviationNameFormatter.
Extract the filename component of an embedded C-string path at a1+0x4714 by scanning backwards for the last backslash (0x5C); return the character after it.

Derive an abbreviated driver display name from the full-name field; primary path looks up the 'Abbreviation' data section, fallback path uses an initial-dot '%c. %-.11s' form; store at this+0x46F8 with NUL at this+0x4707.

Encode a per-vehicle telemetry packet into buffer a2: header marker via ProgressBarEventEncode, then a fixed sequence of bitfield/short/fixed-point encoders for position, speed, wheels, RPM, throttle, gear, clutch, subsystem-ready bits and packed flag word; close via 0x004B2AE0.

Load nationality/career driver info for driver a2 from the nationality array (stride 1060): set full name, fill nationality/short/long description buffers, set abbreviation code, copy flag path to this+0x4714, store driver index at this+0x4898.
Set driver visibility bits (1 and 2) at this+0x48BC and play/stop the matching engine sound via AudioSoundEffectController, gating the own-vehicle sound on the session state.

Render-tick routine: decrement a timer at this+0x4 by dbl_8AFE98 and on expiry call UpdateCameraFOV(0.4); when dword_8AC4C4 is set issue an indirect vtable call (slot 40), then iterate a linked list at this+0xC calling 0x004C8FC0 per node.
One-shot init helper: unconditional side-effect call, delegate with literal 1 to 0x004C7C10, store the status into global dword_8AC4C4, report success as status == 0.

Reinitialise the audio scene: destroy the playlist list (free node data when the alive flag at obj+0x8 is set), clear list state, rebuild .wav and .mp3 playlists via 0x004C84A0, random-start the cursor, and on empty playlist dispatch a scene-index load through the dword_8AC4C4 vtable+72.

Scan a directory for files matching an extension filter and append each hit to the caller list as a node {0,-1} plus an entry {node,0,1}; iterate via DirectoryEntryIterator, tear down the iterator on exit.

Per-frame audio playback manager: ramp the active stream volume (fade-in state 1 clamped at flt_7CF380, else fade-out clamped at 0.0, resetting fade state at this+0x14), or when the mixer is not playing select the next track from the playlist cursor or the scene-indexed table dword_5ACDEC[dword_8AC4C0], submit it through the mixer vtable+4 and refresh.

One-shot audio-scene path and DSP setup invoked from the render tick: when the scene manager dword_8AC4CC reports inactive, submit a '<path base>PitPitsoundsMp' buffer via vtable+4 and apply DSP wetness via vtable+28.
Sound-setup entry point: parse a config token via StringSplitLoop(2, aDDevF119992002_24, 683) and write 'Entered sound setup' through DebugLogWrite when the low byte is non-zero.

Sound-init step: parse a config token via StringSplitLoop(2, ..., 688), log 'Entered sound init' on success, then dispatch a network message referencing the scene-camera parameter flt_8AC4B0. Called from Game_Init.
Sound-restart routine: conditional 'entered sound restart' log, reset virtual dispatch state via 0x004C8630, zero flt_8AC4B0, then reinitialise the audio buffer from flt_5EA618.

Post-cleanup for the sound system called from Game_Post: optional debug log, guarded virtual dispatch on the init-status global, clear flt_8AC4B0, reset one global-object slot and up to 20 stride-8 table entries in the (0,291) validity window.

Sound-system exit routine called from GameExit: optional 'entered sound exit' log, two global vtable dispatches (query 1 and 0), short computation on flt_5EA618, reset virtual dispatch state, return a final arithmetic helper result.
Thin dispatch helper: when dword_8AC4C4 is non-null, call the method at vtable offset 20 as a __thiscall and return its result.
Thin dispatch helper: when dword_8AC4C4 is non-null, call the method at vtable offset 24 as a __thiscall and return its result.
Reset/cleanup of a 15-dword object: zero all dwords this[0..0x38], free the owned pointer at this+0x38 via FreeWrapper_7bcf, return the saved pointer value.

classes.name: FilterPropertiesList
classes.responsibility: Filter-properties linked list with head at this+0x8, tail at this+0xC, current-cursor at this+0x10 and count at this+0x14. Nodes carry a scene index at +0x0, a cleanup flag byte at +0x8 and a next pointer; FilterPropertiesListNodeRemover prunes nodes whose built filter name matches a criterion.

classes.name: F1CVehicle
classes.responsibility: Vehicle/driver record. Driver-region fields: full name buffer (64 bytes starting this+0x4620, NUL forced at +0x465F), 23-byte nationality buffer (NUL at +0x4677), short/long description buffers (NUL at +0x46B7 / +0x46F7), abbreviation output buffer (NUL at +0x4707), state dword at +0x4894, driver index at +0x4898, and visibility flag word at +0x48BC. The packet explicitly tags only NationalityDriverInfoLoader (0x004C78F0) as F1CVehicle; the other driver-region methods are aggregated here on shared field evidence.

classes.name: VehicleTelemetryPacketEncoder
classes.responsibility: Per-vehicle telemetry packet encoder (__thiscall on the vehicle struct, output buffer a2). Reads vehicle physics/state fields (position, wheel suspension, RPM, throttle, clutch, gear, brake factor, steering and per-index flag bytes) and packs them into a bitfield DWORD array via a fixed sequence of packing subroutines. The packet marks its owner UNKNOWN; grouping is DERIVED from the shared this+0x4894 state dword and the player-vehicle globals.

classes.name: FilenamePathHelper
classes.responsibility: Free helper: returns the filename component of an embedded C-string path buffer at a1+0x4714 by scanning back to the last backslash. Owning object type is not established by the packet.

classes.name: CameraTickAndDispatchList
classes.responsibility: Render-tick object holding a timer float at this+0x4 and a linked-list handle at this+0xC whose +0x8 slot is the cursor. On timer expiry it resets the camera FOV and, when the global dword_8AC4C4 is set, dispatches vtable slot 40 and iterates list nodes calling 0x004C8FC0 per node.

classes.name: AudioPlaylistManager
classes.responsibility: Audio playlist state: head at this+0x0, tail at this+0x4, cursor at this+0x8, count at this+0xC, active flag at this+0x10, fade state at this+0x14 and fade speed at this+0x18. Rebuilt by ScanDirectoryIntoPlaylist, destroyed by AudioSceneReinit, and consumed by SoundAudioPlayback for per-frame track selection and volume fading.

classes.name: PlaylistNode
classes.responsibility: Playlist entry node: data pointer at +0x0, next pointer at +0x4 and an alive/cleanup flag byte at +0x8. Freed via FreeWrapper_7bcf; node data is conditionally freed via 0x00404F70 when the alive flag is set.

classes.name: AudioSceneManager
classes.responsibility: Audio scene manager behind global dword_8AC4CC. Accessed only through vtable slots: +8 scene-active query, +4 path submission, +28 DSP wetness setter. No this-relative fields were recovered.

classes.name: SoundSubsystem
classes.responsibility: Sound-subsystem lifecycle and global dispatch helpers. Game-lifecycle entry points (setup/init/restart/post-cleanup/exit) each gate a DebugLogWrite on a StringSplitLoop parse and share the debug buffer dword_8AD25C. The init-status global dword_8AC4C4 holds a sound-system object that is written by 0x004C82C0 and dispatched through vtable slots +20 (0x004C8D60) and +24 (0x004C8D70); no this-relative fields were recovered.

classes.name: SpecialFXState
classes.responsibility: SpecialFX object with fifteen 4-byte slots (offsets 0x0..0x38). resetAndFreePointer zeroes every slot and releases the one owned allocation held at this+0x38.

transitions.on: ScanDirectoryIntoPlaylist appends each matching directory entry to head/tail/cursor and increments count this+0xC; AudioSceneReinit rebuilds the .wav and .mp3 playlists
AudioSceneReinit destroys every playlist node and clears head/tail/cursor/count to zero
SoundAudioPlayback starts a new track with fade state this+0x14 == 1, ramping volume to the clamp at flt_7CF380
volume reaches flt_7CF380; fade state reset to 0
fade state != 1 fades volume down to 0.0
volume reaches 0.0; fade state reset to 0
timer at this+0x4 falls below 0.0 after subtracting dbl_8AFE98
UpdateCameraFOV(0.4) is called and 0.4 is re-added, clamped at 0
SetDriverVisibility with show != 0 ORs 6 into visibilityFlags at this+0x48BC and plays the engine sound
SetDriverVisibility with show == 0 ANDs 0xFFFFFFF9 into visibilityFlags at this+0x48BC and plays the stop sound

interfaces.name: SoundSystemGlobalVtable
interfaces.purpose: Vtable dispatch contract on the sound-system object behind dword_8AC4C4: slot +20 (via 0x004C8D60), slot +24 (via 0x004C8D70), slot +40 (indirect call in TickCameraTimerAndDispatch) and slot +72 (scene-index load in AudioSceneReinit). All dispatches guard on the pointer being non-null.

interfaces.name: AudioSceneManagerVtable
interfaces.purpose: Vtable dispatch contract on the audio scene manager behind dword_8AC4CC: slot +8 scene-active query, slot +4 path submission, slot +28 DSP wetness setter.

interfaces.name: AudioMixerVtable
interfaces.purpose: Vtable dispatch contract on the audio mixer behind dword_8AC4C8 with a volume float at +4: slot +4 play, slot +8 playing/ready query, slot +24 refresh, slot +28 volume set.

interfaces.name: TelemetryEncodePipeline
interfaces.purpose: Fixed per-vehicle telemetry encode sequence: header via ProgressBarEventEncode (0x004B33B0), then position/speed/wheel/RPM/throttle/gear/clutch/subsystem-bit/flag encoders, a player-state bitfield merge via 0x004B2B60 and a final close via 0x004B2AE0.

compatibility_contracts.name: TelemetryPacketLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement must reproduce the per-vehicle telemetry packet: a header/progress marker written by ProgressBarEventEncode (0x004B33B0) from the state dword at this+0x4894 and the session-time double dbl_8AFEA0, followed by the fixed encode sequence (0x004B2310 position pair, 0x004B2480 speed short, 0x004B25D0 fixed-point, 0x004B2750 clamped short, four wheel entries via 0x004B2840, RPM 0x004B2930, throttle 0x004B29B0, gear 0x004B2A10, clutch 0x004B2A40, 14 subsystem-ready bits 0x004B2AA0, flag word, steering 0x004B2B10, player-state merge 0x004B2B60) and the close 0x004B2AE0.

compatibility_contracts.name: DriverNameBufferBounds
compatibility_contracts.description: The driver full-name buffer is 64 bytes starting at this+0x4620; SetDriverName copies at most 63 characters via bounded copy 0x00587DD0 and forces the final byte (this+0x465F) to NUL. The abbreviation output buffer at this+0x46F8 is NUL-terminated at this+0x4707 with a 15-character bound. A replacement must preserve these bounds.

compatibility_contracts.name: FilterPropertiesListInvariants
compatibility_contracts.description: The filter-properties list keeps head at this+0x8, tail at this+0xC, current at this+0x10 and count at this+0x14. Removal unlinks a fully matched node, updates current/tail/head as needed, decrements count, conditionally frees node data (node+0x8 flag) via 0x00414370 and always frees the node via FreeWrapper_7bcf.

compatibility_contracts.name: SoundLifecycleSequence
compatibility_contracts.description: The sound subsystem is entered from Game_Init (Sound_Init), the render tick (TickCameraTimerAndDispatch, SoundSceneDSPConfigUpdate), Sound_Setup/Sound_Restart during the game, SoundPostCleanup from Game_Post and Sound_Exit from GameExit. Each lifecycle function gates a DebugLogWrite into dword_8AD25C on a StringSplitLoop(2, aDDevF119992002_24, N) parse of the same configuration string.

compatibility_contracts.name: SoundInitStatusObject
compatibility_contracts.description: The sound-system object behind global dword_8AC4C4 is created/status-stored by 0x004C82C0 and then dispatched through vtable slots +20, +24, +40 and +72. Every dispatch site guards on the pointer being non-null; a replacement must keep that null-guard contract.

unresolved: Only NationalityDriverInfoLoader (0x004C78F0) is packet-tagged F1CVehicle; SetDriverName, DriverAbbreviationNameFormatter and SetDriverVisibility are aggregated onto F1CVehicle on shared driver-region field evidence. The vehicle-identity aggregation is DERIVED, not confirmed.

VehicleTelemetryPacketEncoder (0x004C71C0) packet owner is UNKNOWN; its fields are grouped on the vehicle struct via the shared this+0x4894 state dword and the player-vehicle globals dword_7C54F0 / dword_7C54DC.
The scene array dword_8AC490 stride 396 and its name field at +260 (FilterPropertiesListNodeRemover) come from raw arithmetic and are not independently named.
node+0x8 is described as a cleanup/flag byte in FilterPropertiesListNodeRemover and AudioSceneReinit but its exact meaning is unverified.
StringCopyWithValidation return semantics (nonzero treated as skip) are inferred from branch placement only.
AudioChannelStop (0x00568210) is reused as an object/field validity probe gating the abbreviation and nationality lookups; its real audio semantics are unexplained.
The word_5C32D8 marker matched by sub_587C20 and the '%c. %-.11s' initial-dot abbreviation format are observed but not semantically established.
sub_589901 post-processing of the formatted abbreviation output is unknown.
Globals 0x008AC368, 0x008AD3B4, 0x0059E440, 0x0059E444, 0x0059E8C8 are listed by packet facts as read but do not appear in the decompiled bodies; roles unresolved.
The concrete class of the mixer behind dword_8AC4C8 (volume float at +4, vtable slots +4/+8/+24/+28) and the scene manager behind dword_8AC4CC are unknown.
The scene-indexed track table dword_5ACDEC[dword_8AC4C0] (wraps at 4) and the pair off_5D325C / dword_5D3254 are inferred from existing analysis, not proven.
Sound_Init's NetworkMessageReceiveAndDispatch callee has no packet callee address; flt_8AC4B0 as a scene-camera parameter is DERIVED prose.
The final buffer-reinitialisation callees in Sound_Restart and Sound_Exit and the ArithmeticComparison_8350 callee in Sound_Exit have no packet callee entries.
The (0,291) validity window and 20-entry stride-8 table reset in SoundPostCleanup have unconfirmed semantics.
DispatchGlobalVtableSlot20 / DispatchAudioSystem return an uninitialized local when dword_8AC4C4 is null (undefined behavior); caller contract on that path is unknown.
Playlist node layout ({data,next,aliveFlag} for teardown vs {0,-1} node plus {node,0,1} entry for ScanDirectoryIntoPlaylist) is GUESS-level; the two layouts are not proven identical.
The vtable slot numbers (20/24/40/72 on dword_8AC4C4, 4/8/28 on dword_8AC4CC, 4/8/24/28 on dword_8AC4C8) are observed call offsets, not independently documented.
The embedded path buffer offset 18196 (0x4714) in PathFilenameExtractor is byte-derived; the owning object type is unknown.
